description: Answers 'is there anything on record for this organization: a breach notice, an 8-K disclosure or a catalog entry?' from a domain or a name. At least one is required; a domain is tried first. found is true only for an exact domain or an exact name (case, punctuation and legal forms such as Inc. are ignored), and then every incident and its sources are returned. A parent domain or a similar name is never treated as the answer: those organizations are listed under candidates. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.

domain.description: A domain such as example.com. This or `name` is required.

name.description: An organization name. This or `domain` is required.
